_note: random_dungeonmagic_level5's loot besides weapons (weapons_table.json) and armour (summoner3/armour.json): the user's table of 2026-10-23, written into the level by pipeline/unreal/857. tiers: the tiers of rooms whose containers may hold it (none: every tier). rarity: how likely a container holds it against the other items of its tier (the item's Weight). The potions and foods are level 4's items (random_dungeon_magic4/items.json: amount, seconds, rarity) with tiers; components and repair items are new. found_max: a container that holds it gives 1 to that many (components come in bundles: the table gives no count, the recipes ask for 5 to 45 of a kind).

tiers._note: by the potions' rank (small, medium, large, uncommon, wondrous, rare, very rare, legendary) and by food

repair._note: found anywhere; repairs: the share of a set of armour's or a found weapon's full durability it gives back (up to full)

recipes._note: made at an anvil. 'wood (any)' is hardwood, timber and wood logs together; 'glue' is Glue (wood glue and epoxy are materials of their own); 'iron', 'bronze', 'copper', 'steel' are the ingots

container_chance._note: the user's, 2026-10-24: a container holds anything at all one time in three; when it does, 1 to 6 items as before (the great hall's armour, start_room_armour, is there whatever)

rings._note: the user's table, 2026-10-24: three kinds of ten. magic potency: +10% to +100% maximum mana (the user's choice of what 'mana effect' means), for the spellcasters (Mage, Warlock, Summoner); hp potency: +10% to +100% hit points, the Warrior and the Warlock; dexterity: +10% to +100% ranged weapon damage, the Rogue. Rings 1-2 tier 1, 3-4 tier 2, 5-6 tier 3, 7-8 tier 4, 9-10 tier 5; rarity 25 each. One of each kind is worn at a time (rings of a kind do not add up); a hero carries rings she cannot wear.

tomes._note: a spell tome is one more item a container may hold (rarity 25, like a ring, every tier); which spell it teaches follows the spell table's drop chances among the spells of the room's tier (spells.json: the user's choice). A hero who learns its type learns it when she finds it; one who cannot carries it.
tomes.name: Spell Tome

breakdown._note: a found weapon broken down at an anvil (the user's choice: by type): blades into steel and iron ingots and cured leather strips, bows into timber, glue and straw rope, crossbows into hardwood, steel and epoxy; each count is per_tier x the weapon's tier (the lowest tier its item is found in)

start_room_armour._note: the great hall's containers (StartRoomItems): tier-1 sets only (the start section is tier 1), one of each weight the first tier has

fire_volume._note: the fires' crackle (the user: too loud): sounds.json's Env.Torch, Env.Brazier and Env.Hearth volumes were 0.55, 0.65, 0.85; now x 0.4 (-8 dB)
